title: Abhanga Tukaram
overview: Abhanga Tukaram based on the Abhanga saga of Saint Tukaram Maharaj A rich collection of saintly literature on the silver screen. Maharashtra has been enriched by the thought of saints. The Abhangagatha of Jagadguru Sant Shrestha Tukaram Maharaj is a very valuable treasure in Marathi literature.
